**[P1] Release the invocation claim even when span shutdown fails**

The span-ending and workflow-export calls above can invoke customer-supplied tracer or processor code and raise. The plugin executor contains that exception, but this cleanup is skipped; the context claim then keeps the discarded plugin alive and registered as open, allowing later logs to resolve to a finished trace and leaving attached OTel context behind. Put invocation-scope release in a `finally` block, apply the same fix to `ExecutionOtelPlugin.on_invocation_end`, and test with a processor that raises from `on_end`.
